backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with data types for patients, lab results, medications, ADRs, narrations, drug interactions, external resources, and prescription OCR.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records linking features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files describing their roles and recent enhancements.
frontend/.env.local: Local development environment variables for network, canister IDs, and dev server configuration.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the root React application and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, profile loading logic, delayed recovery banner, and rendering the dashboard.
frontend/src/backend.idl.ts: IDL definitions mapping backend Motoko types to TypeScript for agent communication.

frontend/src/components/DrugDetailsModal: Modal displaying detailed drug information including status, category, source, date, and safety data.
frontend/src/components/DrugDrugInteract: Provides a searchable drug interaction database UI with filtering, drug selection, manual lookup, and monograph viewing tabs.
frontend/src/components/DrugInteractions: Handles multi-drug, drug-food, and food-food interaction checks with detailed result cards and severity/evidence formatting.
frontend/src/components/DrugMonographSec: Renders pharmacokinetic and clinical monograph sections for a drug, falling back to placeholders when data is missing.

frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Static footer showing branding, copyright, and a use disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the app header with logo and authenticated user info, including logout handling.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsForm.t: Form for submitting lab results with numeric validation, error handling, and field-specific focus control.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsModule: Displays patient details and provides tabs for entering and viewing filtered lab results, with loading states and BMI categorization.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login with logo preloading, error handling, and a secure-access themed UI.
frontend/src/components/MedicationForm.t: Form for adding patient medications with validation, date parsing, focus management, and success/error handling.
frontend/src/components/MedicationsModul: Shows patient info and provides tabs to add medications or view medication history filtered by patient.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyBanTrends: Computes yearly banned-drug statistics and displays them in a dialog with summary cards and a bar chart.
frontend/src/components/MukabotWidget.ts: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/NameAutocomplete: Autocomplete text input that filters suggestions, supports keyboard navigation, and handles click-outside behavior.
frontend/src/components/PatientDetailsDi: Displays detailed patient info including labs, medications, and ADRs with memoized cards and query-based loading.
frontend/src/components/PatientManagemen: Provides a patient list with BMI indicators, selection, deletion, and detail dialogs using memoized rows.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataF: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data form component.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataM: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data module component.
frontend/src/components/PrescriberDetail: Form for viewing and updating prescriber details with validation, loading existing data, and save mutations.
frontend/src/components/PrescriptionUplo: Empty placeholder file for prescription upload functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for collecting and validating user profile info, saving via mutation, and managing focus on invalid fields.
frontend/src/components/RestrictedDrugsM: Displays restricted drug categories with search, collapsible sections, and external resource links.
frontend/src/components/StartupProfileRe: Banner that warns of delayed profile loading and provides retry and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/WavebotWidget.ts: React widget for a chat-style assistant with external resource definitions and UI state handling.
frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts: Provides drug normalization, deduplication utilities, and a large curated dataset of banned and approved drugs.
frontend/src/data/drugFoodInteractionsDa: Defines drug–food interaction types and an expanded dataset detailing mechanisms, risks, and management guidance.
frontend/src/data/drugInteractionExample: Contains preset drug interaction example sets and helper functions to load and validate them.

frontend/src/data/foodFoodInteractionsDa: Lists food–food interaction entries with severity, effects, recommendations, and references.
frontend/src/data/foodList.ts: Canonical list of food names for autocomplete and a helper to retrieve them.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.

frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating patient, lab, medication, and interaction data using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS layers, theme variables, dark mode colors, and performance‑optimized utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard with tabbed modules, lazy loading, prefetching, and patient selection state.
frontend/src/services/cdscoDrugService.t: Simulates CDSCO drug data retrieval with caching and returns sample banned drug entries.
frontend/src/services/drugDrugInteractio: Fetches, caches, and returns drug–drug interaction data with default fallback and sync scheduling.

frontend/src/services/interactionNameCat: Generates canonical drug and food name lists and provides normalization‑aware suggestion filtering.
frontend/src/services/localInteractionCh: Computes drug–drug, drug–food, and food–food interactions client‑side using cached indexes.

frontend/src/utils/dateParsing.ts: Provides utilities for parsing, validating, and formatting dates as nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/drugPairs.ts: Handles normalization, comparison, generation, and labeling of drug name pairs.
frontend/src/utils/formValidation.ts: Contains shared form validation helpers for required fields, email, phone numbers, numeric inputs, and error lookup.
frontend/src/utils/interactionSummary.ts: Generates overall interaction summaries, ranks severities and toxicity risks, and formats labels for display.
frontend/src/utils/nameNormalization.ts: Normalizes names for comparison and detects duplicates by collapsing case, spaces, and punctuation.
frontend/src/utils/namePairs.ts: Generates unique name pairs and formats pair labels for general use.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, plugins, theming, and content paths.
